question: Where’s the closest attraction positioned on the way to Charlesmark Hotel, Boston, MA from Blue Ocean Discovery Center, Hampton, NH?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Blue Ocean Discovery Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Hampton%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NH%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Charlesmark Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Boston%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ), route_line AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry) AS geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ), buffered_route AS ( -- Create a 5km buffer around the direct line between the start and end points SELECT ST_Buffer(geom::geography, 5000) AS geom FROM route_line ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_point sp WHERE p.tourism = 'attraction' -- Ensure the attraction is within the buffered route AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_route)::geography) -- Exclude the start and end points themselves if they happen to be attractions AND NOT ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM start_point)::geography, 1) AND NOT ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM end_point)::geography, 1) ORDER BY -- Order by distance from the starting point ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, sp.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
